provenance.model: Deterministic CPU diffuse transport, one reflected bounce
provenance.geometrySource: Actual src/bench/room.ts indexed/nonindexed triangles with local transforms

light.type: Generated one-sided frosted north-window area emission
light.units: Relative linear radiance, not calibrated lux and not a measured HDRI bake
light.source: Actual room north-glazing material emissive colour times emissiveIntensity

material.description: Declared mean linear diffuse reflectance from exhibition tint, multiplied by actual vertex tone; no material texture samples

recipe.quadrature: Hammersley cosine hemisphere; stratified area-emitter connections
recipe.textureEncoding: RGBA16F, RGB indirect irradiance, A=1, no mipmaps

limitations: Indirect diffuse transport to the back wall only; one bounce.
No specular transport or measured HDRI integration; escaped rays have zero radiance in this window model.
The renderer retains its own direct/key/probe light; the texture contains no direct-emitter term.
Mean diffuse reflectances approximate patterned materials; their three-scale detail remains in the runtime shader.
No claim that the shared stack.gi() stub is functional.
